utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hey Gus, are you going to the repair drive on Saturday? I'm bringing my broken lamp.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure am, Nell! I'll be there after 2 with my tools. I can take a look at that lamp for you.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Gus! I'll see you on Saturday then.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Rosa, have you heard about the repair drive this Saturday at the community center? It's from 10 to 4, and they'll fix your stuff for free!

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Actually, Tess, I think it's been moved to Sunday – do you have the latest flyer?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Wait, really? I thought it was still Saturday—let me double-check my flyer, but I might have an old one.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I... I'll try to bring it, but I can't promise.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Every bit helps, Uli. Just do what you can.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Cleo. I'll see what I can do.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Are we sure we have enough supplies organized for the repair drive? I'm a bit worried about the schedule.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Pia, don't worry! I've been talking to everyone, and it seems like we've got a solid plan. Folks are really excited to bring their stuff, and I think we'll have enough hands to help out.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That's reassuring, Jules, but do we have an exact start time? I don't want anyone showing up confused.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sam said it's this Saturday at 9 AM at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Wait, I thought it was Sunday at 10. Are you sure about Saturday at 9?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, Sam was pretty clear — Saturday at 9. Maybe check with Sam to double-check?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Oren! I'm organizing a repair drive this month. Do you have any broken electronics you'd like to donate?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, a repair drive! I think I have an old toaster somewhere... or was it a lamp? Let me go check.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, thanks for checking! If you find anything, drop-off is at my garage after 3:15 PM on weekdays.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Great, I'll be there. Do you need me to bring anything specific?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Uh, not sure. Maybe just check the flyer? I think it said something about bringing broken stuff.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Alright, I'll look out for the flyer. But if you hear of any specific tools or items needed, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: It's an event where people bring broken small appliances or electronics to the community center, and volunteers help fix them. Vik said it's this Saturday!

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, you got the scoop! I actually have a flyer from the grocery store with the full list of what they're collecting. Want to see it?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, please! I want to make sure I have the correct information.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Hi Leo! Are you planning to join the repair drive this Saturday? I'm mapping out the route and could use any details you have.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, Saturday works for me. I can have my garage open from 2 PM for drop-offs.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, I'll note that. So your garage is a drop-off point at 2 PM—I'll add it to my route.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I think I mixed up the dates—I told Nell it was Saturday. I should let her know.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: No worries, Rey! The repair drive is this Friday evening. I can help you let Nell know—just say the word!

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Quinn, but I can tell her myself. I'll send a quick message.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Sam, have you heard about the repair drive this Saturday at the community center? I'm bringing my old blender!

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Actually, I'm bringing my blender on Monday because Faye said drop-off is on weekdays. But I'll still be there Saturday to help fix things!

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh, I thought it was Saturday! But I'll be there Saturday with my blender anyway.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, is that the bike thing? I'm still catching up.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: No, not a bike thing. It's a repair drive for the neighborhood. But I still haven't seen that list of supplies you mentioned.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: List? Oh right, I think I forgot to bring it... sorry, I've been all over the place lately.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I've got a few old radios and a toaster that needs fixing. I'll bring them by after 3:15 tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Wait, I thought drop-offs started Monday? Is tomorrow okay?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes, tomorrow's fine. Faye said drop-offs are after 3:15 on weekdays, so I'll see you then.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It's a community event where people bring broken stuff—appliances, clothes, electronics—and volunteers fix them for free. I'm bringing my old blender!

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh cool, maybe I'll find something broken around the house too.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great! It's always fun to fix things together. Let me know if you need help finding anything.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I... I'll try to bring it, but I might not stay long.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: No worries, Uli! Even a short visit helps. We'll be at the community center on Sunday from 10 AM.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Oh, Sunday? I thought it was Saturday... but I'll see.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Quinn! Let me know if you need my garage as a staging point for the route.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, Faye! Your garage as a staging point would be great—I'll plan the pickup route to end there after 3:15.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sounds like a plan! I'll make sure the garage is clear and ready for drop-offs after 3:15.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: But what time exactly? Has everyone been told?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I know Gus will be there after 2 PM, and I've been telling people to come on Saturday. But I'm not sure if everyone knows a specific start time.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: We should make sure everyone knows it's from 10 to 4. I can send out a reminder to the group.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hey Ira, are you planning to go to the repair drive this Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, I'm planning to go! I actually grabbed a flyer from the grocery store with all the details—want to see it?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, definitely! I'd love to see what it says.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, Tess! The repair drive—was it about fixing up old bikes? I can't quite remember.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Not just bikes, Oren! It's for anything broken—appliances, electronics, clothes, you name it. Volunteers will fix 'em up for free!

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: A toaster! I think I have an old one in my garage that's been gathering dust. I'll bring it by Saturday morning!

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect, Leo! Having your garage as the drop-off point is a huge help. See you Saturday at 2.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Saturday at 2 works for me. See you then.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks again, Leo! See you Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Opal, have you heard about the repair drive this Saturday at the community center? Jules is bringing a blender, and you can bring small appliances or electronics to get fixed.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, I've got the route mapped out for all the stops. Does Jules have the exact location for the community center?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh, it's at the usual community center on Elm Street. I'm sure Jules has the address if you need it.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yeah, I'm planning to bring my old blender and help out. See you Saturday at 9 at the community center!

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, Sam, have you actually seen that list of supplies I keep asking about?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: No, I haven't seen a list of supplies from you. What supplies are you talking about?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Alright, let's get Mina's brake pads sorted first. I can check my toolbox for supplies.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I've got some wrenches that might help with that. Want me to grab them?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That'd be great, Gus. How about we meet at my place tomorrow morning to sort through what we have?
